name: Example: docs writer
goal: Write a README for this repository that a new contributor can build, run and configure from

members.name: reader
members.prompt: Read this repository for this goal: $GOAL: the build files, the entry points, the configuration and the tests. Write NOTES.md at the top of the repository with what the project does, how it is built and run, and how it is configured, every fact with the file it comes from. Commit it on your branch and report done.

members.name: writer
members.prompt: Start by merging the reader's branch, which holds NOTES.md: git merge --no-edit crew/$CONDUCTOR_RUN/reader (your run is in $CONDUCTOR_RUN). Then write README.md from NOTES.md, for this goal: $GOAL: what it is, a quick start, configuration, development. Keep every command exactly as it is run; mark anything NOTES.md does not establish as an open question rather than guessing. Commit it and report done.
